description: Rothco's Concealed Carry Holster Panel has been designed to fit sub-compact to full-framed pistols and is padded to protect the weapon. For stability and versatility, the gun holster panel features a full hook & loop back panel that can attach to any bag, vest or jacket with loop paneling, the holster panel is ambidextrous allowing both right-hand and left-hand draw. The panel works get with our Advanced Tactical Bag, Tactisling Transport Pack and more!
